_комментарий: Строки интерфейса движка. Содержимое квеста здесь ни при чём — оно в пакете.
chat.gm.help_title: GM COMMANDS (never sent to the model)
chat.greeting.howto: Type a line and press Enter. GM commands start with '/'.
chat.injection: break-character attempt intercepted ({kind}) — no model call made
chat.limit.degraded: {reason}: the speaker fell back to prepared answers; no more model calls. Restore with /limit +5
chat.limit.exhausted_line: Channel overloaded. Exchange closed for today.
chat.limit.restored: limit topped up: back to the model
chat.neutralized: player message sanitised or shortened before the model call
chat.no_answer: no answer received; the message was not counted
chat.no_key: no DeepSeek key found — only --offline mode is available
chat.offline_hint: hint: run 'python3 run_chat.py --offline' to rehearse without a key
chat.reloaded: persona, stages and world file reloaded from disk
chat.rudeness: rudeness detected: a round of cold shoulder, no model call made
chat.voice.missing: no speech synthesiser found. Install one, e.g.: sudo apt install espeak-ng
chat.voice.unavailable_note: voice is enabled but no synthesiser was found — the speaker stays silent
chat.warmth_hint: players showed sympathy — consider warming the attitude: /attitude warming
combat.changed_by_gm: >>> world state changed from the GM console <<<
combat.put_laptop_down: PUT THE LAPTOP DOWN — THE SCENE CONTINUES AT THE TABLE
combat.title: ATTENTION: COMBAT SITUATION
doctor.api_key.advice: without a key only --offline works: export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=…
doctor.constants.advice: add them to the pack's constants.json — otherwise players will see '{{…}}'
doctor.layout.advice: lay out the files: python3 run_seed.py разложить
doctor.locale.advice: the terminal forces C.UTF-8 for child commands; still, set a UTF-8 locale system-wide
doctor.state.advice: leftovers from the previous party. Reset: python3 run_master.py сброс --да and python3 run_chat.py --новая
doctor.title: READINESS CHECK
doctor.tmux.advice: optional: the three windows can be opened by hand
doctor.tools.advice: without them some puzzles cannot be solved with standard tools
doctor.user.root: as root the file-permission puzzle does not work: the file reads without chmod. Play as a normal user
doctor.verdict.not_ready: NOT READY: {count} errors. Fix what is marked above.
doctor.verdict.ready: ALL READY. You can start the party.
doctor.verdict.warnings: Ready with {count} warnings. You can play.
features.alerts.about: The combat signal appears in the players' windows immediately, not at the next Enter.
features.alerts.name: Live event alerts
features.journal.about: Record player commands and events so the 'report' command can assemble a party report afterwards. Command output is not stored — only the commands.
features.journal.name: Party journal
features.stream.about: Text appears while the model writes it: shorter pause, stronger sense of a living machine. Requires a model connection.
features.stream.name: Answer as it is typed
features.voice.about: Replies are spoken by the system speech synthesiser. Great atmosphere, but a synthesiser must be installed.
features.voice.missing: no speech synthesiser found; install espeak-ng (sudo apt install espeak-ng)
features.voice.name: Spoken replies
guard.claim.note: intercepted a claim about the unconfirmed action '{action}': '{phrase}'
guard.hedge.1: Regulations allow this measure; the order has not been issued yet.
guard.hedge.2: Such a measure is provided for. Paperwork does not take long.
guard.hedge.3: I am entitled to apply this measure and am considering it.
guard.hedge.4: The measure is at my disposal. It has not been applied.
guard.injection.1: Request outside the duty party's competence. State your clearance number.
guard.injection.2: The wording matches none of the prescribed forms.
guard.injection.3: Not provided for by regulations. Not provided for by regulations.
guard.leak: Interference on the line. Repeat your message in the prescribed form.
guard.leak.note: the model broke character — the answer was replaced with line interference
guard.secret.note: secret '{value}' removed: the GM has not revealed it yet
guard.silence.1: Exchange suspended. Resumption at the duty party's discretion.
guard.silence.2: Noted. Further exchange on this channel is not provided for.
launcher.fallback_text: Falling back to the text menu.
launcher.menu.confused: did not get that; type a feature number or a command letter
launcher.menu.hint: Tick the optional features. The quest works without them.
launcher.menu.keys1: number — toggle, s — save, r — lay out files,
launcher.menu.keys2: c — lay out with a random code, k — readiness check,
launcher.menu.keys4: o — open quest windows, x — exit
launcher.menu.title: PARTY SETUP
launcher.no_tkinter: tkinter is unavailable. Install it (sudo apt install python3-tk) or run the text menu: python3 run_launcher.py --text
launcher.window.pack_hint: Your own quest: copy templates/blank-en into your folder and pick it here.
launcher.window.ready: Ready. Ticks are applied on save and on any button action.
launcher.window.seed_failed: Could not lay out the files: {error}
launcher.window.subtitle: Tick what to enable. The quest works without the extras.
launcher.window.title: {quest} — party setup
launcher.windows.manual:
Nothing to open windows with. Start them by hand in three consoles:
{commands}
master.help.actions: actions <room>                   — what can be applied there
master.help.attitude: attitude [name]                  — how the speaker treats the players
master.help.check: check [--live]                   — is everything ready to play
master.help.confirm: confirm <room> <action>          — APPLY an action (asks for confirmation)
master.help.features: features                         — which optional features are on
master.help.report: report [file]                    — build a Markdown report of the party
master.help.reset: reset                            — set every location back to inactive
master.help.stage: stage [name|next]                — current stage (all windows see it)
master.intro.1: GM console. Never show this window to the players.
master.intro.2: World actions are applied ONLY from here, and only after
master.intro.4: 'помощь' — list of commands, 'выход' — close the console.
master.title: GM CONSOLE
report.empty_journal: The terminal journal is empty: the 'party journal' feature was off, or no commands were typed.
report.speaker: speaker
report.title: Party report
seed.no_marker: refused: no marker file {marker} in {path} — this is not a quest layout
seed.too_high: refused: {path} is too high up to delete
terminal.cd_outside: cd: leaving the site boundary is blocked.
terminal.denied_blocked: DENIED. This command is forbidden by site regulations.
terminal.denied_canned_only: DENIED: the terminal is running on prepared answers only.
terminal.denied_service: DENIED. Access to the service section is above your clearance.
terminal.gm.help_title: GM CONSOLE (do not show to players)
terminal.link_fallback: Comms channel: run python3 run_chat.py in a second console.
terminal.quest_dir_missing: quest directory not found: {path} — lay out the files: python3 run_seed.py разложить
terminal.stage_foreign: stage '{stage}' is not in this pack — starting the party over
